IV. True or False
1. Preorder + Postorder enough to reconstruct the original tree? FALSE — preorder and postorder do not uniquely
determine a binary tree (unless it is a full binary tree); an inorder sequence is needed.
2. Postorder + Inorder enough to reconstruct the original tree? TRUE — the last element of postorder is the root;
inorder splits left/right subtrees; recurse to rebuild the unique tree.
3. Leaf nodes appear in the same relative order in preorder, inorder and postorder? TRUE — leaves are always
visited left-to-right in all three depth-first traversals.
